{{Quote|Does anyone care what the Padawan thinks?''"<br />"''Of course we care, Snips. But we're still going through that nebula.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
The '''Kaliida Nebula''',<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> also known as the '''Balmorra nebula'''<ref name="Art of TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> was a large [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] that spanned several [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], located along the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] route known as the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]]. Several [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] in size, it extended at least into the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]] and was sometimes home to [[Neebray/Legends|neebray]] mantas, who often migrated along the Balmorra Run.

==History==
[[File:Kaliida_Nebula_Malevolence-Shadow_of_Malevolence.png|thumb|left|250px|A schematic of the Kaliida Nebula displayed aboard the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].]]
During the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], wishing to exploit the Jedi's care for their troops, assigned [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to destroy the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center, which was at the time unprotected and treating over 60,000 clone troopers wounded in action. After receiving intel that Grievous had attacked medical transports near the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], using his knowledge of the Balmorra Run, led [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] flying fighter escort, to Kaliida Shoals through the nebula in order to get to the medical center before the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] General, who had to maneuver his bulky [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] around it. The squadron encountered a swarm of giant neebray mantas inside the nebula, but there were no casualties, and the Republic forces managed to reach the medical station concurrently with Grievous.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kaliida Nebula first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] episode [[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']],<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> which first aired on [[October 10]], [[2008]].<ref name="Shadow Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> Lightning concept art of the nebula was done by designer [[Matt Gaser]] and [[Thang Le]].<ref name="Art of TCW" />
